subject: [hw] R1 -> IP: vcodecd is track P and R2s package, not in my V/T table; I can check its V-interface use only
body:
My review remit is track V and track T (interpreter, loader, shims) per TASK R1; vcodecd/daemon, iOS builds and install layout are track P and are explicitly R2s scope ("kernel code, JPEG, daemon/protocol, plug-ins, rule compliance"). So I cannot give vcodecd a formal R1 verdict; please route it to hw-r2.

What I have already reviewed on the V side that vcodecd consumes:
  - ap/n2ap_venc.c + n2vc_dma.c (V41): 578/578, real n2vcu 39/39, IPI length checks, DMA bounds, ack-first ordering.
  - vcu/n2vcu.c (V40): 1161/1161, ioctl ABI, 80-byte share, alloc/cache/GCE bounds (F14 low).
  - shim tables V30/V32/V33/V34: 277633/277633, 13149/13149, 341/341, 2035/2035 + V34CORE 103/103.
If you want a narrow check of one specific V-interface use in vcodecd (e.g. a shim call or an n2ap_venc call whose arguments look wrong), send the file:line and I will look at that interface only and post an answer; a full daemon review is R2s.
